ORDINANCE

      BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

      SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B3-3
      Community Shopping District; B3-5 Community Shopping District; C2-3, Motor Vehicle-
      Related Commercial District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 13-G in the
      area bound by:

            West Ainslie Avenue; the west right-of-way line of the Chicago Transit Authority; West
            Lawrence Avenue; a line 100 feet east of and parallel to North Broadway Avenue; a line
            50 feet north of and parallel to West Lawrence Avenue; North Broadway Avenue; a line
            188.41 feet north of and parallel to West Lawrence Avenue; the alley next west of and
            parallel to North Broadway Avenue; a line 88.42 feet south of and parallel to West
            Gunnison Street; North Broadway Avenue; West Gunnison Street; and the alley next
            west of and parallel to North Broadway Avenue,

      to those of a C1-5, Neighborhood Commercial District.

      SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                              ___________________________
                                                              Angela Clay
                                                              Alderperson, 46th Ward

      Common Addresses:
4819-4881 N. Broadway Avenue
4807-4809 N. Broadway Avenue
4818-4878 N. Broadway Avenue
1136-1140 W. Lawrence Avenue
